::: {.hero-lead}

## The book

::: {.book-card}
::: {.book-cover}
<span class="book-cover-title">O Manual do Cientista de Dados</span>
<span class="book-cover-author">Wlademir Prates</span>
:::
::: {.book-body}
### O Manual do Cientista de Dados

A free, open handbook in Portuguese about data science in practice: statistics, modeling, visualization and the reasoning behind them. An ongoing project, written in Quarto and open to contributions.

[Read online](https://wrprates.github.io/o-manual-do-cientista-de-dados/){.btn .btn-primary role="button"}
[Source on GitHub](https://github.com/wrprates/o-manual-do-cientista-de-dados){.btn .btn-outline-secondary role="button"}
:::
:::

## Research

Before industry, I did academic research in behavioral finance at UFSC, mostly on how investors decide under risk. These are the papers I would point you to first.

::: {.grid .pubs}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.pub-card}
<span class="pub-venue">Journal of Behavioral and Experimental Finance · 2018</span>
<a class="pub-title" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jbef.2017.12.003">On the neural substrates of the disposition effect and return performance</a>
<span class="pub-authors">Dorow, da Costa, Takase, Prates & Da Silva</span>
:::
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.pub-card}
<span class="pub-venue">Managerial and Decision Economics · 2017</span>
<a class="pub-title" href="https://doi.org/10.1002/mde.2843">Risk aversion, the disposition effect, and group decision making: an experimental analysis</a>
<span class="pub-authors">Prates, da Costa & Dorow</span>
:::
:::

::: {.pub-card}

<span class="pub-authors">Prates, da Costa, Armada & Da Silva</span>
:::
